findings.problem: The example is three sentences, but it should be one short sentence.
findings.fix: example.target: Nein danke, ich mag kein Bier. example.en: No thanks, I don't like beer.

back.example: No, thanks. I don't like beer. I'm drinking water.

note: The hint "use kein" is needed because it rules out "Ich mag Bier nicht" and "Ich trinke nicht gern Bier", and sameAs is rightly null even though the Spanish list has cerveza-beer, because phrase cards never have a sameAs.
